title: Data Migration
items: Which statement describes data migration in Storage Virtualize?
It changes the MDisks to which a volume is allocated without disrupting access to the data
It requires the volume to be offline
資料移轉會變更 Volume 所使用的 MDisk，且不中斷 Volume 資料存取。
When can data migration be used?
When removing MDisks from a clustered system
資料移轉可在移除 MDisk 時使用，也可把資料移到效能合適的 MDisk。
What can be done when adding a system to an existing SAN infrastructure?
Move data from image mode volumes to MDisks
Convert all volumes to cloud volumes
新增系統到既有 SAN 時，可把 Image Mode Volume 的資料移到 MDisk。
What is a use case for migrating storage partitions between systems?
Migrating to a new storage array before decommissioning the original system
Changing the extent size of a pool
Partition 移轉可用於換用新儲存前汰除原系統，或將過載系統的 Partition 移走做負載平衡。
During storage partition migration, when is host I/O served from the target system?
Once the synchronization process is complete
Only after the source system is powered off
目標系統先建立所有關聯資源並開始複製，同步完成後由目標系統服務 Host I/O，最後從來源移除 Partition。
Can a storage partition that has DR replication configured be migrated?
已設定 DR Replication 的 Partition 也可以移轉。
What happens to snapshot policies of volume groups during partition migration?
They are created on the target system and assigned to the volume groups
They remain on the source only
They are converted to cloud policies
若 Volume Group 有 Snapshot Policy，移轉過程會在目標建立並指派。
Which host types are supported for storage partition migration?
Fibre Channel, iSCSI, and NVMe-oF hosts
Storage Partition 移轉支援 FC、iSCSI 與 NVMe-oF Host。
Which resources move with a storage partition during migration?
Volumes, IP addresses, hosts, and partition users
Partition-scoped 的 Volume、IP、Host 與 Partition User 會一起移動；System User、User Group、Ownership Group 不移轉。
Concept Guide Ch12 User access during partition migration
What is required for partition users to authenticate successfully after migration?
They must be associated with an ownership group that exists on the target, and user names must be unique
They must have SSH keys only
Partition User 必須關聯 Ownership Group，且該群組須存在於目標系統，使用者名稱在系統間須唯一。
Which partitions are NOT supported for storage partition migration?
Draft partitions and partitions configured for policy-based HA
Draft Partition 與已設定 Policy-based HA 的 Partition 不支援移轉。
Concept Guide Ch12 Limits and restrictions
How many storage partitions can be migrated at a time from a system?
一個系統同一時間只能移轉一個 Partition，後續移轉會排入佇列依序自動執行。
If a system has partitions configured for HA, where can partition migration be used?
Only with the HA partner system
With any system in the grid
若系統有 HA Partition，Partition 移轉只能用於與 HA Partner 系統之間。
Do partition users move as part of a partition split operation?
Partition Split 時 Partition User 不會移動，Split 或 Merge 後需確認所需使用者存在。
What connectivity is required between source and target for partition migration?
Both Fibre Channel and IP connectivity, the same as HA requirements
Partition 移轉需要來源與目標之間同時有 FC 與 IP 連線，需求與 HA 相同。
Which grid membership condition is required for partition migration?
Both systems in the same grid, or neither in a grid while meeting grid requirements
Only the target in a grid
Only the source in a grid
兩個系統須屬於同一 Grid，或都不在 Grid 但符合 Grid 需求。
What must be established between source and target pools before partition migration?
必須在來源與目標系統間建立 Pool Link。
When upgrading to 9.2.0, what is now a prerequisite for creating FC partnerships for replication?
升級到 9.2.0 時需確認已有 Replication Portset，它是建立 FC Replication Partnership 的前提。
Which source provides the AI-powered placement advisory for partition migration?
Grid GUI 的 Placement Advisory 由 IBM Storage Insights 分析所有系統的歷史資料提供。
Which is a prerequisite for the partition placement advisory?
An IBM Storage Insights Pro license
需所有 Grid 系統在同一 Storage Insights Tenant、具 Storage Insights Pro 授權，並註冊 API Key。
From where can storage partition migration be initiated in the GUI?
Only from the Storage partitions page of the FlashSystem grid
GUI 只能從 Grid 的 Storage partitions 頁面啟動 Partition 移轉，且只能移到同一 Grid 的系統。
Concept Guide Ch12 Using the GUI
Which CLI command starts a storage partition migration?
以 `chpartition -location` (或 -locationuuid) 啟動移轉；`lspartition` 查看狀態。
Concept Guide Ch12 Using the CLI
Which command shows migration progress, including remaining data and estimated completion time?
`lsvolumegroupreplication` 可監控剩餘資料量與預估完成時間。
Which host attribute allows the system to detect automatic storage rescans by hosts?
`mkhost`、`chhost` 的 autostoragediscovery 選項管理 Host 自動定期 Rescan 的屬性。
What should be verified before committing a partition migration?
Host multipath configuration, path availability and redundancy, and I/O performance on the target
Only that the source is powered off
Commit 前需確認 Host Multipath、路徑可用與冗餘，並評估目標系統的 I/O 效能。
How do you abort an active or queued partition migration?
Specify the source system location with the -override option
指定來源系統為 Location 並加 -override 可中止移轉，因為會移除已複製的資料。
During migration of a partition configured for DR that contains recovery volume groups, what must be done?
Pause DR replication temporarily by setting recovery volume groups as independent
若 Partition 含 Recovery Volume Group，需暫時將其設為 Independent 以暫停 DR Replication。
From which system can you roll back a partition migration?
Rollback 從目標系統執行，將 I/O 切回來源；Abort 則從來源系統執行。
Concept Guide Ch12 Completing the migration
Where is a partition migration committed?
在目標系統 Commit 即完成移轉流程。
What marks the completion of a storage partition migration?
An informational event on the target storage system
An error event on the source
目標系統的資訊 Event 標示 Partition 移轉完成。
How are volumes moved into a data reduction pool?
Add a volume copy in the DRP with volume mirroring, then remove the original copy after sync
Use migratevdisk directly to a DRP with a different extent size
以 Volume Mirroring 在 Data Reduction Pool 建立 Copy，同步後刪除原 Copy。
簡報 S6；Concept Guide Ch12 Moving volumes to a data reduction pool
When adding a volume copy to a data reduction pool, which capacity savings must be selected?
在 DRP 建立的 Copy 須選擇 Thin-provisioning 或 Compressed，並可再加上 Deduplication。
How can you speed up synchronization of the new copy?
可在 Volume 上按右鍵選 Modify Mirror Sync Rate 提高同步速率。
Which tools estimate the savings of moving to a data reduction pool?
可用 Data Reduction Estimation Tool (DRET) 與 Comprestimator 估算節省；DRP 中建議用整合式 Comprestimator。
Is host SCSI unmap enabled by default for data reduction pools?
Data Reduction Pool 預設啟用 Host SCSI Unmap 支援。
When a standard child pool is created after encryption is enabled, what happens?
An encryption key is created for the child pool even if the parent is not encrypted
The child pool inherits no key
啟用加密後建立的 Standard Child Pool 會有專屬 Key，即使 Parent 未加密，可用 Volume Mirroring 移入。
Can the -encrypt option be used when creating a data reduction child pool?
No; it inherits the parent's encryption state and key
Only when the parent is not encrypted
Data Reduction Child Pool 繼承 Parent 的加密狀態與 Key，不能使用 -encrypt。
What is the purpose of migrating extents within a parent pool?
To relieve highly used MDisks (hot spots)
Migrate Extents 在同一 Parent Pool 的 MDisk 間搬移資料，以疏解過度使用的 MDisk。
簡報 S7；Concept Guide Ch12 Migrating extents
Can child pools receive migrated extents?
從 Parent Pool 取得容量的 Child Pool 不能接收移轉的 Extent。
Which command shows the number of extents used by each volume on an MDisk?
`lsmdiskextent mdiskname` 顯示每個 Volume 在該 MDisk 上使用的 Extent 數。
Which restriction applies to concurrent migrate extents operations?
A source MDisk cannot be the source of another migrate extents operation at the same time
來源 MDisk 不能同時是其他 Migrate Extents 的來源，目標 MDisk 也不能同時是其他作業的目標。
When the source or target volume is offline or quorum disks are undefined or unavailable
Source 或 Target Volume 離線、未定義 Quorum Disk 或 Quorum 不可用時，移轉指令會失敗。
What happens to an image mode volume when any migration starts?
It is automatically converted to managed mode
任何移轉都會先自動將 Image Mode 轉為 Managed Mode。
Which command migrates a volume between parent pools?
`migratevdisk` 在 Parent Pool 間移轉 Volume，也可改用 Volume Mirroring (addvdiskcopy 與 rmvdiskcopy)。
Can a volume be migrated between pools with different extent sizes by using migratevdisk?
不能在 Extent Size 不同的 Pool 之間移轉，需改用 Volume Mirroring。
Can moving a volume between I/O groups be done concurrently with I/O?
Yes, if the host supports non-disruptive volume moves
No, the volume must be offline
在 I/O Group 間移動 Volume 可與 I/O 同時進行，前提是 Host 支援不中斷移動。
Which volumes cannot be moved between I/O groups with the non-disruptive method?
Data Reduction Pool 內的 Volume 不能使用此方法移動 I/O Group。
What must happen to cached data before changing a volume's I/O group?
It must be written to disk
It must be copied to the new I/O group's cache
系統 Cache 內的資料須先寫入磁碟，才能變更 Volume 的 Configuration。
If recovery occurs on the source system before switchover during a non-disruptive volume migration, what should the user do?
Delete the auxiliary volume on the target and recover the source volume from backup
來源系統在切換前發生 Recovery 時，需刪除目標的 Auxiliary Volume 並從備份復原來源 Volume；要復原已同步資料須聯絡 Support。
If recovery occurs on the target system after switchover, what should the user do?
Delete the source volume and recover the target volume from backup
目標系統切換後發生 Recovery 時，需刪除來源 Volume，並從備份復原目標 Volume。
